summary: Executed backend+frontend testing for QuickPrint mobile redesign scope. Backend contracts passed, but frontend QuickPrint flow is blocked by template-loading/auth integration issues, so preview/output-channel parity checks could not complete.

ui_bugs.issue: Main QuickPrint actions area shows 4 buttons (includes 'معاينة') while requested main output controls were WhatsApp/PDF/Print only.
Current template remains 'جارٍ التحميل…' and Bottom Sheet opens with zero template options; template selection flow cannot proceed.

integration_issues.flow: QuickPrint template loading -> selection -> preview -> output channels
integration_issues.issue: In UI run, template-loading path did not produce usable template list, so selected-template propagation into preview/PDF/print/WhatsApp could not be verified end-to-end.

issues: Bottom toolbar and assistant floating button overlap the dialog action strip in tested state, reducing action clarity on small viewport.

action_items: Fix QuickPrint template loading/auth wiring so /api/document-templates reliably populates filteredTemplates in dialog context.
Align QuickPrint mobile main actions with requirement (only WhatsApp/PDF/Print on main surface) or update acceptance criteria if preview button must remain there.
After template sheet population is fixed, re-verify selected template id parity across preview, PDF, print, and WhatsApp flows.
Reduce mobile overlap between fixed bottom controls and assistant/floating UI on 390px viewport.
critical_code_review_comments: Probable root cause: QuickPrint imports and uses custom axios instance `api` from services/api.js (`axios.create`) while auth interceptors are installed on default axios in App.js. This can leave QuickPrint calls unauthenticated and silently caught, resulting in empty templates and perpetual 'جارٍ التحميل…'.
QuickPrint template-load failure is swallowed (`catch` sets empty templates) without user-visible error, making production diagnosis harder.
No MOCKED API detected in this run; failures came from real integrated environment behavior.

success_rate.frontend: 40% (dialog opens, but core template-switch/preview-channel parity blocked)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Use vehicle id 46de32fb-1d40-4303-af28-43b4f55ee59e and open QuickPrint via vehicle-print-menu-button -> vehicle-print-invoice on mobile 390x844. Observe current template stuck at 'جارٍ التحميل…' and empty quick-print-template-sheet despite backend /api/document-templates returning valid rows under authenticated curl.
rca of the issue: RCA: QuickPrint template retrieval path likely uses axios client without the installed auth interceptors, so protected template requests fail and are swallowed, leaving selectedTemplateId unset. Repro: login, open vehicle QuickPrint invoice; current template never resolves and template sheet has zero options. Mitigation: ensure the same authenticated client/interceptors are applied to `api` instance (or inject Authorization for this client), and surface explicit UI error on template-load failure.
